Entries.Original: Hmmm...
What are you pondering over? Usually you'd be taking up the guitar without a second thought.
You know how lately we've just been working our selves to the bone with all the training and patrol duty?
Yeah. So you want to put band practice on hold for a little bit? That sounds like a great idea.
No, I was thinking we should do a concert to blast all that fatigue away.
That'll have the opposite effect! Fatigue adds up! It's definitely not going to get blasted away by a concert!
Why not? A change of pace is the best cure.
No. The best cure is proper rest.
Naw, she's got a point. I've been thinkin' I wanna blast away my pent-up psychic powers, so this'd be a good opportunity.
You're just pent-up because you haven't found a way to use your psychic powers in battle. That's not really insightful.
I WANT TO SHREEED!!!
Shred what? What kind of impulse are you talking about? This also isn't insightful in the slightest.
I WANT TO SHRED SOME VOCAL CORDS!!!
Strange. A couple extra words suddenly makes it seem like you're talking about the concert.
I've made up my mind. It's do or die!!!
In a war-torn era like this, you should be saving that kind of dramatic declaration for a more serious scene. Also, not at all insightful.
I do my best under pressure, so this is my chance to really let that shine.
Do your best in battle. Why are you putting that much effort into what amounts to a hobby? Not insightful!
What about you, Aoi? You might get nervous at the start, but you'll feel amazing after it's all done.
Maybe that kind of experience of success is exactly what I need right now...
Okay, I...I'd like to do it!
Whaaat?! I thought no one's answers were insightful, but in the end everyone's on board with this?!
Yeah, duh?
What about you, Asakura?!
I'd like to experience that sense of urgency and accomplishment one more time...
If you count Karrie's opinion too, we've got seven votes total in favor.
This is a total loss. I can't even push back against such a large majority vote!
The last concert was pretty short, so let's do a longer one this time.
We can only do one song right now.
Oh, true. I guess we can't run the old set list as it is now. We gotta practice so we can play new songs.
What's the next song we're going to learn? Another cover?
It can get pretty boring just doing covers, so why don't we make new songs starting with this next one?
Okay, genius. Good luck with that.
But we're doing it all together.
Wait, stop. So you're saying we're going to be training, patrolling, writing new songs, and preparing for the concert all at the same time? What do you think we are?
Multi-talented super soldiers.
What kind of weird new job is that?
We're professional multi-taskers of music and combat.
Yeah, I get it. But no, I don't get it.
Anyways, it'll be super fun, so...you wanna do it?
This would be a great time for one of those dialogue selection screens to pop up for me.
C'mon, you'd totally press "Yes"!
I would NOT.
But if you don't, it'd be game over for you!
That's a ridiculously unfair game.
So anyways, let's just get started already!
You're so pushy about this as usual...
So we're just going to start without any specific ideas?
Let's just choose the BPM and chord progression and let it work out from there. Do what you like, what feels best.
Can we really succeed by seeing where the wind takes us?!
That's how I've always done it.
Music is a lot easier than I thought!
That's disrespectful to the people who are actually serious about music.
No wonder they call you "Kayamori, the musical genius"...
We were able to jam it out great last time. I think with where we are now, you're all going to be just fine. So let's do it!
Should we call it a day for today?
Yeah...I think our skills aren't quite there yet.
Let's all practice on our own time for the next jam session!
Why do we have to go out of our way to do that?
